item.title: 10 月份美联储首选的通胀指标（核心 PCE）升至 3.3%，为三年来的最高水平。这是连续第
item.description:
10 月份美联储首选的通胀指标（核心 PCE）升至 3.3%，为三年来的最高水平。这是连续第 68 个月高于美联储 2% 的目标。 12 月 9 日将再次加息 25 个基点，联邦基金利率将升至 4.00-4.25%。

The Fed's preferred measure of inflation (Core PCE) moved up to 3.3% in October, its highest level in three years. This was the 68th consecutive month above the Fed's 2% target. Another 25 bps rate hike is coming on December 9, moving the Fed Funds Rate up to 4.00-4.25%.

item.description:
目前，金价在 2026 年下跌了 18%，创 2013 年以来最糟糕的一年。此前，金价在 2025 年上涨了 64%，这是自 1979 年以来最好的一年。

“回归均值是金融市场的铁律。” ——约翰·博格尔

"Reversion to the mean is the iron rule of the financial markets." - John Bogle

item.title: RT: 股市平均每四年大约下跌一次，熊市是经常发生的事情。投资者应该接受这种风险，因为如
item.description:
股市平均每四年大约下跌一次，熊市是经常发生的事情。投资者应该接受这种风险，因为如果没有图表的左侧（下行），就不会有右侧（上行）。

The stock market goes down roughly once every four years, on average, and bear markets are a regular occurrence. Investors should embrace this risk because without the left side of this chart (downside) there would be no right side (upside).

item.description:
今年，价值型股票的表现优于成长型股票 30% 以上，有望创下有记录以来最大的年度差距。有人预测到了这种逆转吗？不。这就是您多元化的原因 - 因为未来是未知的，没有什么可以永远超越。

Value stocks are outperforming Growth stocks by over 30% this year, on pace for the biggest annual spread on record. Did anyone predict this reversal? No. Which is why you diversify - because the future is unknown and nothing outperforms forever.

item.title: RT: $VIX 今天下跌 26%，是历史上第七大单日跌幅。 令人难以置信的是，这是本月第三次 VIX
item.description:
$VIX 今天下跌 26%，是历史上第七大单日跌幅。

令人难以置信的是，这是本月第三次 VIX 美元单日下跌超过 20%。

波动性的波动性从未如此之高，市场从自满到恐惧，眨眼间又回来了。

The $VIX fell 26% today, its 7th biggest one-day percentage decline in history.

Incredibly, this is the 3rd time this month we've seen the $VIX fall more than 20% in a single day.

The volatility of volatility has rarely been higher, with markets swinging from complacency to fear and back again in the blink of an eye.
